caseNameFull: Lansky v. Savoretti, District Director, Immigration and Naturalization Service
attorneys: David W. Walters for petitioners. Solicitor General Sobeloff for respondent.

opinions.text:
On petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit.

Per Curiam:

The petition for writ of certiorari is granted and the judgment is reversed. United States v. Minker, 350 U. S. 179.
